questions.qtext: It takes six technicians a total of 10 hour to build a new server from direct, computer, with each working at the same rate. If six technicians starts to build the server at 10 AM, and one technician per hour is added beginning at 4 PM, at what time will the server be completed?
questions.solution:
(d)
Total amount of work = 60 man-hours
From 10 AM to 4 pm, 6 technicians = 36 – man hours
From 4 PM to 5 PM, 7 technicians = 7 man hours
From 5 PM to 6 PM, 8 technicians = 8 man hours
From 6 PM to 7 PM, 9 technicians = 9 man-hours
Total = 60 man hours

questions.qtext: The decimal number (–16)10 is represented in 2’s complement form as ‘XXXXX’. If the same number is represented in 2’s complement form using 1 byte, then it is represented as
questions.solution:
(d)
2’s complement of (–16) = 1’s complement of (10000)2 + (00001)2 = (10000)2. Thus, MSB bit of (–16)10 in 2’s complement form is ‘1’.
Therefore to represent it with 1 byte (8 bit), MSB bit is repeated and thus, 2’s complement form is obtained as 11110000.
Therefore, option (d) is correct.
